title: State Revenue Office Vic expands AI use in its contact centre
headline: State Revenue Office Victoria expands contact centre AI deployments
summary: State Revenue Office Victoria has advanced to its fourth AI use case tied to a Genesys contact centre system. The agency initially deployed Genesys Copilot to assist agents and generate after-call summaries, and has since introduced voice-activated call routing to triage customer requests across its 28 revenue lines.
why_it_matters: Public sector agencies deploying generative and voice AI tools in citizen-facing operations must manage operational risks while seeking efficiency gains, as demonstrated by SRO Victoria reducing its triage team call load from 500 calls down to between 250 and 300.

quotes.text: State Revenue Office Victoria is on its fourth AI use case tied to a Genesys system that is used in its contact centre operations.
That has reduced the call load on the triage team from 500 calls a day to between 250 and 300.

classification.significance_reason: Provides a practical public sector case study on deploying contact centre AI and voice routing, though it lacks deep operational risk or assurance detail.
